#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-segment isolation, state precedence and retained raw evidence."""
import hashlib, ipaddress, json, os, subprocess, sys

SUB = "/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py"
WORK = "/workspace/scratch/work5"
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
fails = []

def canary(seed, w, s, net64):
    p = ("ipv6-evidence-v1\n%d\n%s\n%s\n%s\n" % (seed, w, s, net64)).encode("ascii")
    c0 = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(p).digest()[:8], "big") | (1 << 63)
    return c0, c0 ^ 1

def A(v): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))

def check(label, cond, extra=""):
    if not cond:
        fails.append(label); print("FAIL[%s] %s" % (label, extra))

def replay(man, rows):
    mp = os.path.join(WORK, "m.json"); open(mp, "w").write(json.dumps(man))
    rp = os.path.join(WORK, "r.jsonl"); open(rp, "w").write("\n".join(rows) + ("\n" if rows else ""))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def row(pid, recv, tgt, src, t=129, c=0):
    return json.dumps({"probe_id": pid, "received_ms": recv, "target": tgt,
                       "source": src, "type": t, "code": c})

# two subnets in one window
MAN = {"version":1,"seed":3,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,
       "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[
           {"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8:1::/56","subnets":[0,1]}]}]}
B0 = int(ipaddress.IPv6Address("2001:db8:1::"))
B1 = int(ipaddress.IPv6Address("2001:db8:1:1::"))
X = A(B0 | 1)   # address in subnet 0

# segment0: internal reply from X ; segment1: error sourced at X
rows = [row("w/s/0/low-1/0", 0, X, X),
        row("w/s/1/low-1/0", 40, A(B1 | 1), X, 1, 1)]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
s0, s1 = res["segments"]
check("two segments", len(res["segments"]) == 2)
check("iso s0 internal", s0["internal"] == [X], repr(s0["internal"]))
check("iso s0 external", s0["external"] == [], repr(s0["external"]))
check("iso s0 state", s0["state"] == "usable", s0["state"])
check("iso s1 external", s1["external"] == [X], repr(s1["external"]))
check("iso s1 internal", s1["internal"] == [], repr(s1["internal"]))
check("iso s1 overlap", s1["overlap"] == [], repr(s1["overlap"]))
check("iso s1 state", s1["state"] == "usable", s1["state"])

# alias_suspect precedence over ambiguous
C0, C1 = canary(3, "w", "s", "2001:db8:1::/64")
C0b, C1b = canary(3, "w", "s", "2001:db8:1:1::/64")
rows = [row("w/s/0/canary-0/0", 60, A(B0 | C0), A(B0 | C0)),
        row("w/s/0/canary-1/0", 80, A(B0 | C1), A(B0 | C1)),
        row("w/s/0/low-1/0", 0, X, X),                      # internal X
        row("w/s/0/low-2/0", 20, A(B0 | 2), X, 1, 1)]     # external X -> overlap
res = replay(MAN, rows)
s0 = res["segments"][0]
check("prec state alias", s0["state"] == "alias_suspect", s0["state"])
check("prec exposure", s0["exposure"] == "excluded", s0["exposure"])
check("prec overlap kept", s0["overlap"] == [X], repr(s0["overlap"]))
check("prec hits", s0["canary_hits"] == [0, 1], repr(s0["canary_hits"]))
check("prec cls", s0["targets"][0]["classification"] == "alias_suspect", repr(s0["targets"][0]))
check("prec raw kept", s0["targets"][0]["internal_attempts"] == [0], repr(s0["targets"][0]))
check("prec raw kept2", s0["targets"][1]["external_attempts"] == [0], repr(s0["targets"][1]))
check("prec raw kept3", s0["targets"][1]["external_sources"] == [X], repr(s0["targets"][1]))

# canary hit only in segment 0
rows = [row("w/s/0/canary-0/0", 60, A(B0 | C0), A(B0 | C0)),
        row("w/s/0/canary-1/0", 80, A(B0 | C1), A(B0 | C1))]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
check("canary iso s0", res["segments"][0]["state"] == "alias_suspect")
check("canary iso s1", res["segments"][1]["state"] == "usable")
check("canary iso s1 hits", res["segments"][1]["canary_hits"] == [])

# canary error (not a hit) but retained as a response -> does not affect low targets
rows = [row("w/s/0/canary-0/0", 60, A(B0 | C0), "2001:db8:ffff::1", 1, 0)]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
s0 = res["segments"][0]
check("canary err state", s0["state"] == "usable", s0["state"])
check("canary err hits", s0["canary_hits"] == [])
check("canary err external", s0["external"] == [], repr(s0["external"]))
check("canary err exposure", s0["exposure"] == "inconclusive")

# multiple responses for one probe are valid; silence is per attempt
rows = [row("w/s/0/low-1/0", 0, X, X), row("w/s/0/low-1/1", 10, X, X),
        row("w/s/0/low-1/1", 11, X, "2001:db8:ffff::2", 1, 2)]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
t = res["segments"][0]["targets"][0]
check("multi resp silent", t["silent_attempts"] == [], repr(t))
check("multi resp internal", t["internal_attempts"] == [0, 1], repr(t))
check("multi resp external", t["external_attempts"] == [1], repr(t))
check("multi resp cls", t["classification"] == "mixed", repr(t))

# accepted anomalous row keeps the attempt non-silent but adds no evidence
rows = [row("w/s/0/low-1/0", 0, X, "2001:db8:ffff::9", 129, 0)]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
t = res["segments"][0]["targets"][0]
check("anom echo silent", t["silent_attempts"] == [1], repr(t))
check("anom echo internal", t["internal_attempts"] == [], repr(t))
check("anom echo cls", t["classification"] == "unknown", repr(t))
rows = [row("w/s/0/low-1/0", 0, X, X, 1, 0)]
res = replay(MAN, rows)
t = res["segments"][0]["targets"][0]
check("anom err silent", t["silent_attempts"] == [1], repr(t))
check("anom err external", t["external_attempts"] == [], repr(t))
check("anom err cls", t["classification"] == "unknown", repr(t))

print("extra failures:", len(fails), fails)
PYEOF
